review.summary: Independent cross-review split the original aggregate buckets, verified all 91 journeys against source/spec authority, and drove corrections until the project/Space, inventory/billing, action-modal, shared-control, and media batches each returned GO. The final catalog contains 167 unique covered surface IDs, 0 uncovered IDs, 299 control groups, 928 named options, 294 transitions, and 398 visible or edge states.

outcomes.title: Discover authorized Accounts
outcomes.outcome: Show environment/Principal-bound Account IDs and safe names in deterministic order, allowing equal names but rejecting duplicate IDs. Preserve version/time/readiness and distinguish complete zero membership from loading, partial, stale and failed discovery.

outcomes.title: Select an Account workspace explicitly
outcomes.outcome: Require explicit selection even for one Account. Produce a local intent only for an ID in the exact displayed snapshot; reject changed or rebound evidence. Activation separately enforces authorization, and MCP uses bounded request/session context.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Target Online Entry and Account Onboarding

outcomes.title: Remember workspace preference without automatic activation
outcomes.outcome: Remember the last Account only within the same environment and Principal. If still visible it may sort first, but it never becomes automatically selected or grants access; ignore a missing remembered ID without disclosure.

outcomes.title: Fail workspace selection without disclosure
outcomes.outcome: Use bounded non-enumerating failures. If cached discovery is retained on failure, label it stale or partial. Reject malformed or rebound evidence and expose no credentials, provider paths, financial values or hidden membership details.

outcomes.title: Resolve rejected work before ordinary logout
outcomes.outcome: Preserve unresolved rejected operations across restart and ordinary logout. Implement a retry or acknowledgment only after O-051 settles responsibility transfer; closing review never resolves or deletes accepted work.

outcomes.title: Create a Project for an existing Client
outcomes.outcome: Create a stable-ID Project for the selected same-Account Client with validated name, optional description, eligible categories and exact nullable allocations as one durable observable result. Duplicate names are valid. Media reconciles separately; expose accepted/pending/rejected state, never silent partial setup.

outcomes.title: Browse Projects
outcomes.outcome: Browse same-Account Active/Archived Projects with alphabetical cards, Client/hero display, create entry and honest readiness. Active's Inventory card opens Account-scoped Items/Transactions/Spaces with remembered section and shared child workflows, never a fake Project. Budget preview and planning remain separate.

outcomes.title: Open Project detail
outcomes.outcome: Open the exact same-Account Project with honest readiness and routes to Item, Transaction, Space, Notes, Budget, Invoicing and Reports workflows. Compose the separately verified financial Transaction browser and owning mutations; host navigation alone never proves totals, financial visibility or write authority.

outcomes.title: Rename a Project
outcomes.outcome: Rename only the selected Project under the approved name, role, archived/same-value and revision rules. Preserve Client identity, description, media, categories, lifecycle, children and accounting; those use separate operations. Never use rename as ownership reassignment.

outcomes.title: Archive a Project
outcomes.outcome: Confirm the selected active Project and observed revision; stale selection/revision invalidates confirmation. Offline confirmation durably accepts archive and moves it from Active to Archived as pending. Preserve children/history, allow cancel and show failure; this action never also restores.

outcomes.title: Apply the Project deletion policy
outcomes.outcome: A synchronized Project cannot be physically removed in a way that orphans history or dependent records.

outcomes.title: Browse scoped active Spaces
outcomes.outcome: List active Spaces in one exact Account/Project-or-Inventory scope with deterministic case-insensitive name order, display-name/ID ties and distinct duplicate names. Open exact-ID detail; distinguish empty, incomplete, stale, failed and disappeared data. Search and full card evidence are separate obligations.

outcomes.title: Create a direct Space
outcomes.outcome: Create one stable-ID Space in immutable Project or Inventory scope with validated name and optional notes, duplicate names allowed. Preserve Create/Cancel and drafts on failure; durably accept offline intent, then validate current membership and exact parent. No template, media, checklist or Item side effects.

outcomes.title: Toggle a Space checklist item
outcomes.outcome: Toggle the selected stable-ID task from exact scoped checklist evidence, durably offline with visible pending/rejection. Preserve other tasks and order; detect competing edits instead of silently replacing newer state. This never sets Space reconciliation completion or accounting.

outcomes.title: Edit and save Space checklists
outcomes.outcome: Add, rename, remove and order checklists/items; edit text and checked state. Save one complete stable-ID replacement against the expected Space revision; stale concurrent edits conflict atomically. Empty collections/lists are valid. Cancel only an unaccepted draft; accepted work remains durable.

outcomes.title: Show checklist progress
outcomes.outcome: Derive per-list and aggregate checked/total counts from the same represented checklist state. Empty lists and collections are valid and must not divide by zero or imply completed reconciliation. Show unknown/incomplete evidence honestly, not fabricated zero or completion.

outcomes.title: Manage shared Space templates
outcomes.outcome: Browse active ordered templates with name, optional notes and checklist count. Add/edit name, notes and checklist structure; cancel retains data. Authorized save, archive and reorder have durable visible outcomes, not silent independent writes. Reset stored checked state; shared grants remain O-026.

outcomes.title: Assign or move Items to a Space

outcomes.title: Calculate budget progress
outcomes.outcome: Compute each category from direct Client-paid records and frozen collected allocations plus open Item charges/credits, Expenses and Fees. Collection changes paid/unpaid composition, never total. Same-Client Transfer is net zero; unresolved category/provenance prevents an authoritative complete total.

outcomes.title: Apply budget sign conventions
outcomes.outcome: Use canonical scope-relative cash, Item charge/credit and paired Transfer contributions, not source Sale/paymentToBusiness multipliers. Preserve signed amount and exact category/cycle provenance; never manufacture movement Transactions or count settlement cash twice.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Sign convention for inventory movement transactions

outcomes.title: Pin and unpin personal budget rows
outcomes.outcome: Preserve Pin/Unpin and ordering for one Principal/Project under O-040, including Overall, absence versus explicit empty, first-view Furnishings, stale/deleted/archived IDs and zero-activity cases. Do not copy the magic sentinel or automatic writes as approved policy.

outcomes.title: Keep budget changes durable and conflict-aware
outcomes.outcome: Keep accepted allocation/category edits and ordering durable across restart; replay once, expose stale/conflicting/rejected results and retain drafts/evidence. One operation cannot report success after partial ordering/setup. Shared and Project permissions remain distinct; recovery uses shared policy.

outcomes.title: Represent nonphysical receipt lines
outcomes.outcome: Represent ordered receipt lines with stable unique UUIDs, source description, positive line-total magnitude, increase/decrease effect and optional quantity evidence. Reject empty descriptions/invalid magnitudes/duplicate IDs. Quantity does not redefine totals; no fixed cost taxonomy or fake physical Items.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Interaction with vendor refunds and non-cash credits

outcomes.title: Reconcile receipt completeness exactly
outcomes.outcome: Determine final-amount completeness from qualifying physical Item evidence plus signed receipt lines, not subtotal/rate or percentage tolerance. Keep exact residual visible for Purchase and Return; the one-cent verdict and physical tax basis await O-030/O-031. Billability is a separate decision.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Tax and subtotal are not completeness inputs

outcomes.title: Preserve non-Item line lifecycle
outcomes.outcome: Keep each line on its original Transaction or Expense receipt owner through physical Item movement. Never create Item IDs, Space/status/media/lineage or automatically copy lines into another Project/Invoice. Preserve order/references and frozen history; billing and non-cash adjustments use separate stories.

outcomes.title: Migrate non-Item receipt evidence
outcomes.outcome: Complete canonical receipt import/readiness under approved treatment, basis and posting rules. Retain raw source/media, signed equations, parent/Invoice/marker references and explicit quarantine; reruns duplicate neither lines nor media. Preservation/quarantine checks may proceed before final promotion.

outcomes.title: Interpret payments relative to the scope owner
outcomes.outcome: Project Purchases and Returns record Client money; Inventory Purchases and Returns record Business money. An Invoice is a demand, not proof of payment.

outcomes.title: Record a direct Client-paid purchase
outcomes.outcome: Create the Project Transaction immediately; physical Items belong to Furnishings and non-itemized costs use the selected category. Neither enters Invoicing.

outcomes.title: Acquire Business-paid physical goods
outcomes.outcome: Create the Inventory acquisition with Items and receipt evidence. Selling an Item into a Project creates an invoiceable Item charge without a second Project Purchase.

outcomes.title: Capture a Business-paid non-itemized Project cost
outcomes.outcome: Capture vendor, date, amount, receipt, notes and category as an Expense in Invoicing; create the Project Transaction only when the Invoice is paid.

outcomes.title: Keep Additional Requests non-additive
outcomes.outcome: Item charges and credits remain Furnishings; Additional Requests is an overlay and must not duplicate the amount in overall spend.

outcomes.title: Edit an Expense according to its lifecycle
outcomes.outcome: Preserve vendor, amount, receipt, notes and category while enforcing approved edit rules for available, invoiced and collected Expenses.

outcomes.title: Handle manual Invoice adjustments explicitly
outcomes.outcome: Allow only the approved adjustment types and categories; never hide a source-less amount inside an Invoice.

outcomes.title: Resolve credit-only and zero-dollar Invoices
outcomes.outcome: Verify three separate branches under their approved rules: credit-only settlement, nonempty net-zero settlement, and an empty Invoice after final-line removal (including created versus sent state). Never treat zero or negative demand as a positive cash Purchase.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Story 3: Remove It from a Created or Sent Invoice

outcomes.title: Revise and deliver a sent Invoice
outcomes.outcome: Apply approved sent-membership changes, preserve revision/delivery evidence and prevent collection against an invalid sent revision.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Story 3: Remove It from a Created or Sent Invoice

outcomes.title: Keep receipt evidence with the actual purchase
outcomes.outcome: Retain vendor, date, final amount, image, physical and nonphysical receipt details on the actual Transaction or Expense. Moving Items never manufactures a separate Receipt entity or silently reallocates receipt-wide costs.

outcomes.title: Choose how receipt costs become billable
outcomes.outcome: Apply explicit approved treatment to tax, shipping, warranty, discounts and credits instead of copying Transaction-wide amounts into an Item charge.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Tax and subtotal are not completeness inputs
Billing decision that must remain explicit

outcomes.title: Record an actual vendor cash refund
outcomes.outcome: When a scope owner actually receives vendor money, record a Return in that owner’s scope. Validate the approved canonical posting evidence; a vendor cancellation or non-cash account credit belongs to the separate vendor-adjustment story.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Story 11: Return an Item to an Outside Vendor
Interaction with vendor refunds and non-cash credits

outcomes.title: Settle Client credit without fabricating cash
outcomes.outcome: Keep pending credit as non-cash evidence; use approved Invoice application or actual cash refund with linked settlement and a Return only when the Client receives money.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Story 4: Remove It after the Invoice Was Paid

outcomes.title: Post and correct Transactions without erasing history
outcomes.outcome: Route Transaction detail/list edit, cancel, delete and correction through approved posting rules with exact selection, confirmation, denied/canceled/error and success navigation. Preserve paid history and audit; never treat a mistaken association as a sale/refund or duplicate a screen-specific writer.

outcomes.title: Keep placement and accounting relationships distinct
outcomes.outcome: Preserve acquisition, current placement, open billing, live and paid Invoice membership, frozen Transaction membership and provenance as distinct relationships; cross-record changes are atomic and retry-safe.

outcomes.title: Inspect all pending local work
outcomes.outcome: Before ending or removing a session, produce one environment/Principal/Account-bound summary with exact queued, applying, unresolved-rejected operation counts and captured bytes whose upload is unverified.

outcomes.title: Log out only after a fresh clean summary
outcomes.outcome: Allow ordinary logout only when every pending class is zero; detect new accepted work or a changed summary before teardown so a stale clean decision cannot discard work.

outcomes.title: Keep sync-first logout pending until work settles
outcomes.outcome: Keep the session open until a fresh same-scope summary proves authoritative or explicitly resolved operations and verified or explicitly resolved captured attachments.

outcomes.title: Confirm exactly which pending work is removed
outcomes.outcome: Destructive local removal is the only path allowed to discard pending work. Require explicit confirmation bound to the exact current scope, summary and counts; invalidate changed evidence and never claim discarded work reached the server.

outcomes.title: Cancel logout without starting teardown
outcomes.outcome: Cancel or close the prompt without an end-session request. Signout, sync shutdown, queue/media/database/key removal, cache cleanup and cleanup recovery remain behind coordinated teardown; no feature may invoke them independently.

outcomes.title: Resume interrupted cleanup before protected data reopens
outcomes.outcome: Treat termination, token expiry, revocation and interrupted cleanup as no destructive consent. Resume fail-closed cleanup before the same Principal can reopen protected local data.

outcomes.title: Carry Fee demand through Invoice collection
outcomes.outcome: Planned Fees remain visible in Invoicing and contribute once to unpaid progress, whether available or on a live Invoice. Collection freezes their membership/category value into paid contents and removes active demand without double-counting spend.

outcomes.title: Record vendor cancellation or account credit without fake cash
outcomes.outcome: Use the approved non-cash adjustment representation and settlement rules for vendor cancellation or account credit. Do not invent a fourth Transaction type or a Return before the scope owner receives money.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Story 11: Return an Item to an Outside Vendor
Interaction with vendor refunds and non-cash credits

outcomes.title: Define what Client Summary totals represent
outcomes.outcome: Use the approved paid/open/physical-value meanings and category breakdown in Client Summary. Do not label active physical Item prices as Client cash paid or silently omit Expenses, Fees, credits, collections or Transfers.

outcomes.title: Share receipt evidence only through the approved report policy
outcomes.outcome: Apply the approved eligibility and durable delivery rules for receipt evidence in client-shared reports. Do not embed raw private object paths, expiring Storage tokens or unintended internal evidence in a PDF.

outcomes.title: Show Item charges and credits without movement jargon
outcomes.outcome: In Project Invoicing, show positive charges, negative credits and available, live-Invoice or paid states. Keep useful Item history understandable without asking users to manage an Item Movement entity.

outcomes.title: Explain Item cycles and Project movement history
outcomes.outcome: Read Item cycles and Project inbound/outbound events with kind filters. Retain source/destination/category, signed amount/price basis, reversal and Invoice/line membership with open/paid/reversed/corrected state. Deduplicate correlated events; expose partial/redacted history honestly.

companionAuthorityRefs.heading: Sign convention for inventory movement transactions

outcomes.title: Freeze exact Item membership at collection
outcomes.outcome: Whole-Invoice collection atomically freezes Item/occurrence IDs, signed amount, category, label and price snapshot; attaches each occurrence to the single Purchase, removes active demand and leaves placement unchanged. Retries, concurrent return and price edits cannot duplicate or rewrite paid evidence.

outcomes.title: Use Add Item and Link language
outcomes.outcome: Add Item opens one wizard; Quick is its lightweight completion, not another object or writer. Use Unaccounted For Items, Accounted For Items and Link; do not expose proto, draft, conversion, promotion, Needs Assignment, Assign Item, Unlinked Items or Linked Items as target labels.

outcomes.title: Continue from capture into optional details
outcomes.outcome: In the same wizard optionally enter SKU, vendor/source, purchase price, project price, market value, status, acquisition Purchase and accounting Link. Preserve the saved Item ID while adding details; payer guidance remains subject to the separate open hint decision.

outcomes.title: Seed the same Item flow from each entry point
outcomes.outcome: Project capture keeps Project/optional Space; Inventory has no Project. Transaction preselection requires eligible scope/type. Images/MCP fields seed the same real-Item writer. Save & Next resets only after durable acceptance; no duplicate or separate capture object.

outcomes.title: Browse shared Item lists, cards and details
outcomes.outcome: Preserve contextual Item sections/counts, list/card/detail, query/sort/facets/grouping, visible selection/totals and picker-only behavior with honest readiness. Show exact identity, placement and occurrence-based history; keep detail bookmark/filter, not an unwired card toggle. Edits use owning workflows.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Unaccounted For and Accounted For Items

outcomes.title: Review or cancel either Link route
outcomes.outcome: Link asks Who paid for this Item? with only Client paid and Business paid. Closing leaves the Item Unaccounted For with no side effects; there is no Not sure yet option. Review the exact accounting destination/effect before commit. Never label Business paid as Sell from Business Inventory.

outcomes.title: Save a real Item without accounting demand
outcomes.outcome: Allow a project Item with enabled Furnishings category, no Transaction or occurrence and optional prices/vendor/SKU/status/Space. Category alone is not accounting. Unaccounted For Items contribute nothing to budget, Invoice, Transaction completeness, reports or exports; later Link preserves identity.

outcomes.title: Reconcile duplicate evidence explicitly
outcomes.outcome: Use a separate audited Reconcile Existing Item action when receipt/MCP/migration reveals duplicates. Choose one surviving ID, merge media/evidence deterministically, redirect only mutable relationships and preserve paid history. Never force matching into normal Link or merge silently.

outcomes.title: Use the same Item contract in MCP
outcomes.outcome: MCP uses the app’s minimum-field real-Item writer and one trusted idempotent command per Link route, with target Item/Link names. Automation may suggest payer, Purchase, duplicates or details but never Links, migrates or merges silently. Existing source tools remain unchanged until authorized cutover.

outcomes.title: Rehearse target intake without changing Firebase
outcomes.outcome: Before authorized cutover, keep production Firebase app/MCP, proto documents, fields, media cleanup, rules and indexes unchanged. Test the full target and import repeatedly in isolated Supabase/PowerSync using immutable fixtures; target-only Item writes never reach Firebase or its users.

outcomes.title: Open target writers only after the approved gate
outcomes.outcome: Keep target production writers disabled until the approved compatibility/authority gate passes, including app/MCP/nonfinancial projections, reconciled legacy proto dispositions and final stale-writer freeze/recovery. Opening production authority is separately authorized, not implied by passing local tests.

outcomes.title: Make intake and Link safe under retries and competing edits
outcomes.outcome: Validate scope, identity/placement/accounting state, Purchase eligibility, occurrence uniqueness, category, project-price floor, live Invoice and authority version. Creation/Link/reconciliation leave no partial records or retry duplicates; delete/move/Transfer/collection/price races fail or serialize.

outcomes.title: Create a Project and its new Client
outcomes.outcome: Create the chosen new Client and the Project’s authoritative relationship, categories and exact allocations through one observable setup result. Require approved Client/Project names and authorization; do not fall back to free-text ownership or leave silently incomplete setup.

outcomes.title: Update or clear Project description
outcomes.outcome: UpdateProjectDetails trims edge whitespace and clears a whitespace-only description. It changes only description, never names, categories, media, lifecycle, children or accounting. Preserve save/cancel and durable outcome rather than swallowing background failures.

outcomes.title: Restore an archived Project
outcomes.outcome: Offer distinct confirmed restore for the selected archived Project, preserving identity, children and history and returning it to Active. Cancel leaves it unchanged; expose pending/failure instead of treating restore as archive or silently losing it. Keep source-navigation parity distinct from target layout.

outcomes.title: Choose Project categories without losing the draft
outcomes.outcome: Show ordered active eligible categories with Itemized/Fee badges and no General badge. Preselect once without overwriting later choices; require at least one for new setup. Back preserves draft; deselection removes its draft allocation. Existing zero-category Projects remain valid readable states.

outcomes.title: Create an Account category from Project setup
outcomes.outcome: Add Category is an authorized shared Account mutation under O-026, not permission implied by Project creation. On success expose it Account-wide and select its returned stable ID in the draft; surface failures. Canceling Project setup must not silently delete a separately created shared category.

outcomes.title: Choose, replace and retry the Project image
outcomes.outcome: Show optional image selection/preview and existing-image loading or placeholder. Retain bytes and thumbnail work across restart until verified upload, with retryable failure independent of Project creation. Replace without silently purging shared/history bytes; no new remove control is implied.

outcomes.title: Preserve Project form navigation and outcomes
outcomes.outcome: Prefill edit values; preserve data across Back/Next, required-field/category guards, optional fields and cancel-without-Project-change. Missing Account, save failure, pending work and conflicts must be visible; do not copy immediate dismissal with suppressed background errors.

outcomes.title: Export the intended Project Transactions
outcomes.outcome: Project Options opens CSV export for current Transactions filters only when invoked from that tab; otherwise export all Project Transactions. Bind export to the exact Project and honest data readiness, not a silently incomplete or wrong-scope snapshot.

outcomes.title: Capture and manage Project notes
outcomes.outcome: Keep Notes/Quick Note distinct from description: multiline capture/send, stable-ID edit, confirmed/canceled deletion and scoped MCP substring search. Preserve metadata, newest-first order, empty-state input and attempted text on failure. Share app/MCP text rules; never drop accepted notes.

outcomes.title: Preserve initial and legacy Project notes
outcomes.outcome: Retain initial Project.notes content and individual notes separately from description, including source correlation and existing metadata. Show legacy content without inventing author/time or merging distinct records; replay/import must not duplicate or discard notes.

outcomes.title: Capture initial notes during Project creation
outcomes.outcome: Preserve optional initial Notes alongside description during Project creation. Retain its content and distinct meaning in durable setup and later notes display; do not drop the field or turn it into description. Apply the approved Project-note text contract.

outcomes.title: Update Space name and notes
outcomes.outcome: Prefill name and multiline notes; preserve Save/Cancel and required-name feedback. Replace the complete normalized name/optional-notes pair for exact Space ID/revision; whitespace-only notes clear. Never change immutable scope; stale edits conflict visibly and accepted intent survives restart.

outcomes.title: Search Space names
outcomes.outcome: Preserve case-insensitive name containment in both scoped browsers, query clearing and distinct no-Spaces versus no-matches states. Freeze shared cross-platform matching/normalization before verification; a filtered incomplete cache cannot establish that no matching Space exists.

outcomes.title: Show complete Space cards
outcomes.outcome: Show name, authorized primary/first image or honest placeholder, Item count and checklist progress. Zero Items requires complete visibility-safe evidence; missing/stale/partial Item or media data remains unavailable. Checklist progress never substitutes for the separate Space completion flag.

outcomes.title: Create a Space from a real template
outcomes.outcome: Select an authorized stable template in the exact creation scope, copy notes and ordered checklists with every task unchecked, then allow customization. Replace the unavailable-picker stub with real loading/empty/failure states; template use never grants shared-template mutation authority.

outcomes.title: Save a Space checklist as a template
outcomes.outcome: Save the selected Space checklist structure as a real new shared template, resetting every checked value. Preserve cancel and visible pending/failure; never report success without durable acceptance. Keep the source Space unchanged and authorize shared-template creation separately.

outcomes.title: Clear Item placement
outcomes.outcome: Clear selected Items in one common Project-or-Inventory scope, even from different current Spaces. Validate each exact revision/current Space and apply all-or-nothing/idempotently; close old-photo green Item links without deleting images/bytes or changing red review notes and accounting.

outcomes.title: Choose an exact-scope placement destination
outcomes.outcome: Show only active exact-scope Spaces with stable IDs/revisions, deterministic name order and current-selection mark. No Space clears placement; Close cancels. Distinguish complete empty from partial/stale/failed evidence; missing cached rows never prove no destination or grant authorization.

outcomes.title: Resolve rejected checklist work
outcomes.outcome: Retain the exact accepted checklist intent and rejection across restart; review and close cannot erase it. Corrective retry or do-not-retry resolution must follow approved O-051 responsibility and evidence rules, separate from canceling an unaccepted editor draft.

outcomes.title: Expose shared Space operations through MCP
outcomes.outcome: App and MCP use the same typed Space creation, details, checklist and Item-placement commands with identical validation, scope, revision, authorization and durable outcomes. MCP cannot bypass role decisions or reinterpret missing local evidence; UI-only checks do not prove this story.

outcomes.title: Manage Space photos durably
outcomes.outcome: Add uncapped Space images with durable local bytes, upload/retry and visible failure; select primary media for detail/cards. Remove only the authorized reference under approved retention rules, never assume immediate byte deletion. Preserve stable media identity across upload and restart.

outcomes.title: Inspect and print Space media
outcomes.outcome: Preserve media expand/collapse, image/PDF pinning, navigation, zoom/pan and unpin controls from the exact-control catalog. Print only resolved non-uploading images with loading/failure feedback; PDFs never expose photo matching. Missing offline bytes must be visible, not pretend available.

outcomes.title: Match Items to Space photos
outcomes.outcome: Use stable photo/Item identities for single and grouped one/two-location green markers. Preserve cancel/redo/save gating, move/reassign/remove and clear-all across photos, not just the pinned one. Persist visibly across offline restart; keep red review-note marks and Space completion separate.

outcomes.title: Record Space review observations
outcomes.outcome: Create/edit/delete text observations, newest-first with author/date and optional same-Space photo/red marker. Preserve text-only notes, photo selection/change/removal, marker positioning and failure drafts. Do not mix general notes, Project Notes, green Item markers or duplicate image bytes.

outcomes.title: Resolve manual Space completion behavior
outcomes.outcome: Account for the existing Mark space complete/incomplete control and persisted reconciliation flag, independently of checklist and photo-match progress. Its target meaning is not approved: preserve source evidence and require an explicit preserve/redesign/retire decision before claiming completion.

outcomes.title: Open and add Items within a Space
outcomes.outcome: Preserve exact-Space Item list/count, shared search/sort/filter/group/selection, Item detail or unavailable state, Create New preassigned to this Space and Add Existing Items. Delegate accounting and placement to their shared commands; never change immutable scope through navigation.

outcomes.title: Browse category settings
outcomes.outcome: Show authorized active and archived non-system categories separately, ordered active rows, badges, edit/archive/restore entries and distinct empty states. Cached partial data is not complete absence; preserve stable IDs and historic labels without leaking hidden Fee names or totals.

outcomes.title: Archive or restore a category safely
outcomes.outcome: Confirm archive or restore an exact category through authorized durable commands. Remove from new selection without losing historical category meaning; protect system rows and all accounting dependencies, not only Transactions. Failed or stale mutations stay visible, never hard-delete used history.

outcomes.title: Reorder shared categories atomically
outcomes.outcome: Drag eligible category rows and submit one complete expected-revision order. Disabled rows remain immovable; duplicate/missing IDs, concurrent edits and failures are visible. Apply all-or-nothing across Account readers; do not reproduce independent silent per-row writes.

outcomes.title: Apply defaults only to eligible entry routes
outcomes.outcome: Preserve protected idempotent Account category seeds and an authorized configurable default where selection is permitted. Physical Item demand remains Furnishings and collected payment categories remain frozen allocations; defaults cannot override writer eligibility or create duplicate seeds.

outcomes.title: Show the intended Project card and pinned header
outcomes.outcome: Display authorized amounts and ordered personal preview rows with honest readiness. Resolve pinned, no-pin, Furnishings/overall fallback and zero-activity behavior under O-040; source UI and old spec differ. A preview cannot hide missing data behind authoritative zero or expose restricted values.

outcomes.title: Explain category and overall budget progress
outcomes.outcome: Show each eligible category's paid/unpaid amounts, signed total, remaining/over and zero/null-budget state, plus overall and non-additive overlays. Preserve information affordances and overflow without implying unpaid Fees were received. Negative-credit display remains O-005; expose incomplete data.

outcomes.title: Choose only categories valid for the operation
outcomes.outcome: Bind category choice to the exact Account/Project and writer's allowed types/visibility/enabled state. Offer No Category only where valid; Close preserves state. Keep stable selection and empty/incomplete/error states; generic source picker options do not authorize invalid category or auto-enablement.

outcomes.title: Explain incomplete and historical budget values
outcomes.outcome: Rebuild projections from canonical contributions with local freshness/completeness and exact category/source evidence. Keep archived history explainable; missing categories or permissions cannot silently drop value. Withhold complete totals when evidence is unresolved, while showing honest allowed partial data.

outcomes.title: Open Project budget management from the right context
outcomes.outcome: Preserve Budget-tab no-configuration state, category/overall rows and eligible Manage Budget entry from its host. Open the exact Project's allocation flow without changing selection or writing defaults merely by viewing; capability and local readiness govern availability.

outcomes.title: Edit Other receipt lines
outcomes.outcome: Save Other receipt lines on eligible Transaction/Expense parents under approved locks and authorization: wording, effect, amount, optional quantity, stable edit/remove and order. Preserve unaccepted draft/cancel and failed input; accepted app/MCP saves survive restart. Read-only detail is separate.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Billing decision that must remain explicit

outcomes.title: Explain the exact receipt equation
outcomes.outcome: Show physical Item sum separately from increase/decrease/net line totals, reconstructed final amount and exact signed residual, in audit/next steps and MCP. Tax/no-tax never requires a positive tax rate or inferred subtotal. Distinguish unknown basis/history from numerical zero; verdict is separate.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Tax and subtotal are not completeness inputs

outcomes.title: Export receipt-line evidence
outcomes.outcome: Export authorized Transaction/Expense receipt evidence as readable and structured ordered lines, with applicable audit totals. Preserve identity, source wording, sign, magnitude and quantity; never flatten away details or present hidden/incomplete evidence as complete. Client sharing is separate.

outcomes.title: Preserve parsed receipt adjustments
outcomes.outcome: Preserve parsed shipping/tax/refunds/warranties/discounts/credits with stable source/candidate provenance and order through review. Retrying must not duplicate canonical lines or media. Ambiguity remains reviewable, never a fake Item; posting uses the approved parent workflow.

outcomes.title: Use the same receipt model in app and MCP
outcomes.outcome: Complete app/MCP receipt saves share validation, Transaction/Expense authorization/locks and durable outcomes. Readers retain ordered lines on editable and frozen parents plus applicable audit totals. Retire target discount arguments and advice to create fake Items; unaccepted drafts remain separate.

outcomes.title: Read ordered receipt details without edit permission
outcomes.outcome: Show ordered individual lines on authorized Transaction and Expense detail, including posted/read-only/frozen parents: exact source wording, signed magnitudes, optional quantity and stable identity. Distinguish a known empty line array from missing/unmigrated/partial evidence; edit permission is not required.

outcomes.title: Use cached work without pretending it is complete
outcomes.outcome: Under approved offline access, show authorized cached records, budgets/audits and local search without a network wait. Distinguish partial, stale, failed, known-empty and uncached evidence; never infer complete history or report readiness from connectivity. Lease and financial scope remain separate gates.

authorityHeadingRefs.heading: Rule 3: Only Block on Actual Uploads

outcomes.title: Keep offline edits durable and their status honest
outcomes.outcome: For otherwise-authorized supported edits, navigate only after durable local acceptance; show local failure, pending and authoritative outcomes across restart. Retry without duplicate effects; retain rejected intent without stalling unrelated work. Use each command's conflict rules; O-051 owns resolution.

Why separate structured and media queues?

outcomes.title: Capture and deliver attachments without losing originals
outcomes.outcome: Across create/detail flows, retain protected scoped bytes, stable ID, metadata and receipt before acceptance. Show after restart; privately upload/verify without duplicates and retry derivatives separately. URLs are not identity; missing pending bytes are visible errors. O-023 separately gates byte deletion.

outcomes.title: Sign in, join an Account and recover access
outcomes.outcome: Preserve email/Google signup/sign-in and error/loading controls, invite acceptance and zero-membership Account creation with safe retry. Use explicit Account selection after success. Network-only identity/recovery cannot masquerade as offline unlock; provider/linking policy remains O-057.

outcomes.title: Reopen only authorized local work
outcomes.outcome: Reopen exact-scope downloaded work without expiry or extra Ledger unlock. Learned Account removal locks normal access and stops removed-user uploads; retain unsynced work encrypted. Financial-scope reduction and recovery procedure remain under O-058. No new downloads, leaks or silent loss.

outcomes.title: Remove media without destroying shared or pending evidence
outcomes.outcome: Separate removing a parent reference from deleting bytes. Apply approved retention, authoritative shared-reference checks and recoverable quarantine before permanent deletion; preserve pending capture and history. Ordinary cleanup, retry and logout cannot bypass explicit pending-work disposition.

outcomes.title: Apply approved Fee and whole-Invoice visibility
outcomes.outcome: Use approved full/limited/none grants and explicit Fee IDs; unknown revenue fails closed. Whole Invoices hide when any protected Fee is unavailable; never partially redact. Classify target Invoicing sources, not legacy payment types or all Expenses. Mixed payments and manual adjustments remain gated.

outcomes.title: Keep hidden financial data out of every read path
outcomes.outcome: Enforce one approved visibility policy before server reads, sync downloads, local data/media, search/review, budgets, reports/exports and MCP. Hidden amounts/counts/names/Invoice IDs/provenance cannot leak. Reduce online grants promptly; offline cache and retained work follow O-058, not immediate revocation.

outcomes.title: Manage member roles and financial access safely
outcomes.outcome: Show authorized member directory/badges and Access editor: Role, Full/Limited/None, conditional Fee checklist, Invoice explanation, Save/progress/error/Cancel/empty states. Apply exact member/revision changes together under approved ownership/self-lockout rules; never silently drop archived Fee grants.

outcomes.title: Invite and revoke with the intended grant
outcomes.outcome: Preserve validated email, Employee/Admin and financial-access choices, Limited Fee checklist, pending invitation rows, Copy Link and confirmed Revoke. Show sending/revoking/failure without silent success. Apply approved actor/role/grant policy and safely reconcile acceptance through target identity.

outcomes.title: Import financial grants and visibility evidence faithfully
outcomes.outcome: Preserve source member/invite grants and derive target Fee/Invoice/frozen visibility evidence without broadening access or duplicating invites on rerun. Retain original provenance and authorized unresolved-classification reports; unknown revenue stays full-only. Final promotion uses approved target policy.

outcomes.title: Preview and deliver a complete authorized report
outcomes.outcome: Preserve per-kind entry, preview and PDF/print/share/CSV/MCP delivery from one complete authorized versioned/as-of snapshot. Resolve assets before pure rendering; show unknown/missing/error states. Use deterministic rows and protected scratch files cleaned after confirmed handoff, never original/user exports.

outcomes.title: Render the selected Invoice and its actual evidence
outcomes.outcome: Route the Invoice report entry through the existing Invoice browser. Render exact live or frozen paid contents, signed groups/totals, status, notes and revision evidence. A linked Purchase explains payment without adding demand again; never substitute generic Project arrays or current Item price repairs.

outcomes.outcome: Preserve Property Management preview/share with Project/address/date, Space groups plus No Space, Item name/SKU/market value, count/value footer and meaningful empty/failure states.
